stem:
Neither slavery nor involuntary servitude, except as a punishment for crime whereof the party shall have been duly convicted, shall exist within the United States, or any place subject to their jurisdiction.

—Thirteenth Amendment, U.S. Constitution
instruction: What was an IMMEDIATE effect of this amendment?

options.label: A
options.text: Many plantation owners attempted to recapture former slaves.

options.label: B
options.text: Many plantation owners were forced to give land to former slaves.

options.label: C
options.text: Many former slaves became sharecroppers to earn a living.

options.label: D
options.text: Many former slaves were awarded money by former Confederate leaders.

visual_elements: text box containing Thirteenth Amendment quotation
